subject: Deep technical walkthrough request: hosted API integration
messages:
From: Sarah Chen <sarah@nexahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-01 09:12 -0400
Subject: Deep technical walkthrough request: hosted API integration

Hi Grace,

We're ready to move from PoC to a production integration and would like a deep technical walkthrough focused on the Hosted API. Key items: SDK integration patterns, streaming responses, and best practices around function/tool calling. Our infra lead (Daniel) will be on the call.

Can you or someone from Redwood run a 60–75 minute session next week? We're in Eastern Time (UTC-4). Ideal windows for us are: Tue 2027-05-04 10:00–12:00 ET or Wed 2027-05-05 14:00–16:00 ET.

A short agenda would be great so we can invite the right people.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Chen
Head of Integrations, Nexa Health
attachments: none
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-01 11:03 -0400
Subject: Re: Deep technical walkthrough request: hosted API integration

Hi Sarah — great to hear you're ready to progress. Thanks for the time windows. Karthik (runtime) and Marissa (developer experience) are copied — they will cover kernels/latency tradeoffs and SDK demo respectively.

Proposed slot: Tue 2027-05-04 10:30–11:45 ET (75 minutes). If that works we'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and attach a proposed agenda and a short preflight checklist.

Draft agenda (attached as PDF):
- 10m: Introductions & success criteria
- 20m: SDK walkthrough (auth, streaming API, reconnection patterns)
- 20m: Runtime/serving patterns (batching, KV cache, latency knobs)
- 15m: Function/tool calling and security considerations
- 10m: Rollout plan & next steps

Attachments: redwood_integration_agenda_v1.pdf, integration_preflight_checklist.csv

If you need earlier, we could push to 10:00 but we wanted that 30m buffer for Karthik. Please confirm and we'll lock the invite.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_integration_agenda_v1.pdf, integration_preflight_checklist.csv

Thanks Grace — that slot is almost perfect. Quick note: our ML infra lead is in Pacific Time (UTC-7) and has a standing conflict at 10:30 ET. Can we move to 11:00–12:15 ET on Tue? Also would it be possible to include a short segment on function calling security (token scopes and least privilege)? I'll add him to the invite when we confirm.

Regards,
Daniel

Hi Daniel & team — thanks for the heads-up. 11:00–12:15 ET on Tue 2027-05-04 works for us; locking that in. We'll cover token scopes and least-privilege patterns in the function calling segment and include a short checklist for KMS/HSM integration.

Updated agenda (attached):
- 5m: Goals and success metrics
- 20m: SDK integration demo (auth flow, streaming reconnection, client-side retries)
- 25m: Serving runtime & performance knobs (batching profiles, quantization tradeoffs, KV cache lifecycle)
- 15m: Function/tool calling (auth scopes, payload signing, fallback policies)
- 10m: Runbook & rollout plan (canary, fallback, metrics to monitor)

Action items before the call:
- Nexa: share a short sample prompt set and expected peak QPS (Daniel)
- Redwood: share runbook draft and invite list (we attached proposed_runbook.md)

I'll send the calendar invite (Zoom + dial-in) and include the attachments. If anyone on your side needs to join from APAC, tell us the names and we'll add a recording option.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor

Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-05-04 16:45 -07:00
Subject: [Internal] Nexa Health 11:00 ET run-through — heads up

Karthik / Marissa — quick note to confirm you're on deck for the Nexa deep dive tomorrow (Tue 2027-05-04 11:00–12:15 ET).

Call will cover: SDK demo, streaming reconnection edge cases, batching/latency knobs, function calling auth scopes. Please have the following ready:
- Karthik: brief slide on batching profiles and kernel selection (5–7 slides) and an example trace showing latency under burst load.
- Marissa: a short live demo of the JS SDK streaming client (2–3 min) and a fallback example for tool calling failures.

I'll send the calendar invite with Zoom and add Nexa participants. If you need to swap, tell me now.

Thanks — Grace
